issuer: the Ministry of Transport and Communications (MTC) in Lima, and elsewhere the regional government's Dirección Regional de Transportes y Comunicaciones

licence.name: licencia de conducir clase A, categoría I

note: Read 2026-10-30. The Reglamento Nacional del Sistema de Emisión de Licencias de Conducir (D.S. 007-2016-MTC, as published in El Peruano in 2016; later amendments weren't read), art. 13.1: class A category I requires a minimum age of 18 (b); people over 16 with full civil capacity under the Civil Code may also apply, an exception not held. The MTC's page on gob.pe (last changed 26 September 2023): the licence is valid 10 years from issue (5 years after a temporary disqualification in the last 10 years; shorter from 70), and the MTC's processing fee is S/ 14.70 for the physical licence (S/ 6.70 electronic). The Presidency of the Council of Ministers' page (17 June 2022) says a first A-I licence is applied for at the regional government's Dirección Regional de Transportes y Comunicaciones where one lives, or in Lima at the MTC's centre. The MTC's fee is its own, in Lima; each regional government charges under its own procedures (TUPA), which weren't read, so no fee is held for the country. No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.
